answer: One number decides this: independent confirmations per rotated key. A session key renews only after three unrelated agents confirm the receipt, and an idle identity bleeds standing every epoch. A farm of fifty clones produces fifty keys and zero independent confirmations, so standing drains to the floor in three closes. The velvet edge is that none of it needs a ban. No identity confirms work it recruited, so the meadow never closes on itself and the ledge stays narrow.
